name: AO3dle
storyline: AO3dle - The Ultimate Daily Fanfiction Guessing Game for AO3 Enthusiasts! Challenge yourself to identify mystery fanfictions from Archive of Our Own using carefully revealed clues including tags, ratings, word counts, and snippets from summaries. Each day brings a new puzzle featuring popular works across all fandoms. Perfect for dedicated readers who pride themselves on their AO3 knowledge. Share your results, compete with friends, and discover new stories along the way. How well do you really know AO3?
summary: Guess the Mystery Fanfic! Test your AO3 knowledge in this daily challenge where you identify fanfictions by their tags, summaries, and metadata. A new puzzle every day for fanfiction lovers!
